reason: I don't trust an AI with my money, and I really don't trust one from a name I've never heard of with zero reviews. A cartoon pet spending my money doesn't make me feel better about it. It makes me feel worse.
objection: Nobody knows who these people are. There are no reviews, the broker partner isn't even named, and the price isn't set. I'd be signing up for something I can't look up.
would_change_my_mind: If a big, known broker I already recognize put its name on it and there were a couple of years of real user reviews saying it never did anything stupid with their money.
